**Who we are**

We build and run cold-email sending infrastructure as a product — Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace tenants, domains, DNS, mailboxes, and deliverability. 

A customer orders 100 tenants and 10,000 mailboxes and expects them to appear, working.

We are a small, fully remote team with live customers and real revenue. You would be our senior engineering hire, working directly with the founder.

**What we're looking for**

• A senior engineer who has run a production SaaS system, not only built features inside one

• Someone who has been the only backend engineer somewhere — the person called when it broke at night

• Strength in catching silent failures: an order marked complete before the work actually 
happened, while the dashboard looks healthy for two days. Queues, transactions, migrations.

• Comfortable owning the backend and shipping the Next.js admin and customer interfaces on top of it — roughly 70/30 backend to frontend

• Works fluently with AI tooling and reviews its output critically

**Requirements**

• 4–6 years of backend experience, with genuine ownership of a production system

• TypeScript and Node.js in depth — not JavaScript with type annotations

• PostgreSQL at depth — transactions, row locking, indexing, and migrating a schema under live traffic. Managed-database experience alone is not enough.

• Redis and BullMQ, or equivalent job queues — retries, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and what happens when the same job runs twice.

Long-running workers rather than serverless; if your recent experience is primarily Lambda and API Gateway, it will not map cleanly to this stack.

• Production browser automation — Puppeteer, Playwright or Selenium against real third-party portals. Not scraping: authenticated, multi-step flows including MFA, which have to be idempotent and safe to re-run. 

This is core infrastructure for us, not a side concern — when it breaks, provisioning stops.

• Express (or NestJS — the concepts transfer)

• Next.js and React — able to build and ship a working admin screen end to end, unassisted

• Prisma, or any ORM you know well enough to reason about the SQL it generates

• REST API design — authentication, idempotency keys, rate limiting, versioning

• Docker, and comfort working in Linux and the command line

Our stack runs on Railway and Vercel.

**Nice to have**

• Microsoft Graph, Google Workspace Admin SDK, or similar vendor API integration at scale

• Email infrastructure — SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and deliverability

• Stripe or subscription billing

• Experience migrating a live system between codebases with users on it

Likely not a fit: consultancy or service-company backgrounds built on a series of short client projects, or engineers who have only worked inside a framework someone else set up.

**Hiring process**

We keep this short and respect your time. Nothing unpaid takes more than 30 minutes.

1. Apply — CV
2. Short Loom video — if we're interested, we'll send three questions that you can answer in a quick loom video
3. Introductory call — 20 to 30 minutes with the founder
4. Technical interview — with a senior engineer
5. Paid trial — real work, paid at your rate, on our development environment

**Looking for a Technical Co-Founder 🚀**

I’m building **Capsules AI**, and I’m looking for someone who wants to build the company with me — not just join it.

Here’s the problem we’re trying to solve:

A customer walks into a furniture or décor store.
They like a sofa. They take a few pictures.
They say, **“Let me think about it.”**
And walk out.

For the retailer, that customer is usually **lost**.

We’re building a system that changes that.

The customer can take that experience home with them — **visualise the actual product in their own room, explore the right alternatives, and discover products that genuinely work together.**

Not just:

> “Here are 20 products you might like.”

But:

> **“Here’s your room, recreated with products that fit your space, style, colours and proportions — and here’s the combination that creates a cohesive look.”**

The goal is to make product selection feel less like shopping and more like **having a designer who knows what you like.**

And there’s a lot more we want to build around this — AI agents, conversational shopping, knowledge graphs, visual AI, intelligent product discovery and more.

### 🧠 The tech stack

**Node.js | Next.js | React | LangGraph | LLMs | Knowledge Graphs | Prompt Engineering | AI Agents | Visual AI**

### 👋 Who I’m looking for

I’m looking for a **Technical Co-Founder** who:

* Wants to build something **from 0 → 1**
* Is excited about AI, product and solving real-world problems
* Can own the technology stack and make architectural decisions
* Is comfortable experimenting, failing fast and figuring things out
* Most importantly, wants to **build a meaningful company**, not just another project

You don't need to tick every technology on the list.

**I care more about how you think, how you build and whether you have the hunger to create something.**

### ⚡ One important thing

**This is an equity-only Co-Founder role.**

There is no salary being offered at this stage.

You would be coming in as a **founding member of the company**, with meaningful ownership and the opportunity to shape the product, technology and company from day one.

If the idea makes you curious, or you’ve been waiting for the right problem to build around — **let’s talk.**

📩 DM me with your LinkedIn/GitHub and a little about yourself + something you've built that you're proud of.

**Looking for a builder who wants to say one day:
“We started with an idea. We actually built it.”**

🚀

**Role**: Founding Engineer

**Company**: Guile

**Location**: Greater Hyderabad Area (Hybrid)

**Type**: Full-time


**About the Job**
We're building autonomous AI agents that break web applications before real attackers do–and we need our Founding Engineer.
Most security tools throw a wall of theoretical, static false positives at developers. We're building Guile AI penetration testing platform where coordinated agents run persistent recon, write working Proof-of-Concept (PoC) exploits, and chain minor flaws into full exploit paths.


**The Role**
This isn't a slice of a larger engineering org–you'd be building the core of the product itself. You'll own the multi-agent layer: coordinating specialized agents (recon, exploitation, post-exploitation) so they hand off findings to each other and escalate a chain of small issues into a real exploit path, and pushing that toward an always-on model with persistent parallel agents running continuously, not one-off scans kicked off by a CLI command.


**What You'll Do**

●Design and build a multi-target, persistent agent orchestration layer.

●Design how agents coordinate–shared state, findings handoff, escalation logic.

●Build enterprise features: SSO, audit logging, compliance-ready reporting.

●Own the security logic itself–payload design, exploit validation, false-positive reduction–not  just the infrastructure around it.

●Ship fast and alone, with minimal process.


**You Probably Have**

•Python at a real engineering level–services and tools shipped to users, not scripts.

•Hands-on experience building agents: tool/function calling, multi-agent state sharing, context management (via LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or a custom framework).

•Real offensive security depth: OWASP Top 10 fluency, hands-on exploitation experience, comfort with Burp Suite, Nuclei, sqlmap, nmap.

•Docker-based sandboxing and CI/CD (GitHub Actions is fine).


**Mindset**
High agency–no one's writing tickets for you, you decide and build.
Genuinely into both halves of this role (AI agents and offensive security)–one without the other won't work here.
Comfortable being the only engineer, with real ambiguity, for a while.


**Nice to Have**
Basic exposure to SSO, audit logging, or RBAC–it's on the roadmap.
Prior work on an autonomous security or AI-agent product, open source or commercial

Dostack helps enterprises own their AI. We build AI-powered workbenches tailored to how enterprise teams actually operate - their capabilities, constraints and culture. AI handles research, analysis, drafting and checking, while people retain judgment, accountability and control.

The opportunity
We are looking for a hands-on Solutions Architect to lead that implementation alongside the founders and engineering team.
You will sit between the customer's platform, security and business teams and Dostack's product and engineering team. You will take the implementation from technical discovery through deployment, integration, workflow validation and operational handover.
THIS IS A HANDS-ON IMPLEMENTATION ROLE ; You should be comfortable running a customer workshop in the morning, configuring Kubernetes in the afternoon and debugging an identity or API integration issue the next day. You will also help turn what we learn from this first deployment into a repeatable implementation model for future enterprise customers.

### Why we’re building Carbon Trail?

The fashion industry is responsible for ~10% of global greenhouse gas emissions (GHG) and more than 90% of its emissions stem from the supply chain. Most fashion brands and retailers lack actual supply chain data and therefore, struggle to meet environmental impact disclosure regulations. The existing software solutions are generic and lack industry-specific insights like the impacts of recycled and organic materials, manufacturing technologies used across different fabrics & products, and the ability to collect and integrate energy resource consumption data from suppliers.
This is why we created Carbon Trail, a software platform tailored to the fashion industry. Leveraging data and AI/ML, our product provides instantaneous product environment footprint (PEF) reports and critical analytics that cover the lifecycle of any fashion product. This helps fashion retailers and brands accurately measure the environmental footprints of their products which can then be used to create digital product passports, get a deeper understanding of their Scope 3 emissions, and identify emission reduction initiatives to meet their net-zero goals.
Among our founders, we have experience leading the development of groundbreaking data, IoT, and AI/ML products at Microsoft and other startups. We also have hands-on experience building climate strategies for global clients and implementing clean-energy solutions like solar. We believe climate change is the greatest challenge facing humanity and want to dedicate our careers to fighting against it.

### What You Will Do

We're looking for a full-stack software engineer who can work on both the backend (AI/ML stack, APIs) and front end (customer-facing web app). You will work directly with the CTO on multiple segments of the product as it evolves which will include designing and implementing:
Leveraging AI to extract useful information from unstructured data and fill gaps using intelligent machine learning-based heuristics.
Evolve the front-end application using the latest open-source technologies in the market like React/NextJS, Tailwind, etc.
Build integrations with ERP/PLM systems used by brands/retailers to fetch data in real time.
Augment our LCA engine to cover a wider range of materials, products & processes as we grow.

### What Will Make You A Great Fit

Can you thrive in an early-stage environment: small team, fast-moving, with lots of ownership and willingness to do what it takes to keep shipping? or
Do you have significant experience in an early-stage environment, especially as a CTO or an early employee?

In addition, possessing the following technical skills will make you an excellent fit:

*  5+ years of experience developing frontend and backend systems
*  Strong computer science fundamentals (Data Structures and Algorithms, OS primitives) and ability to design systems end-to-end
*  Familiarity with SaaS infrastructure components like AuthN/AuthZ, multi-tenant architectures, observability etc.
*  Highly skilled in Object Oriented Programming in languages such as C#, Java, Typescript, Python
*  Experience working with databases like MongoDB, PostgreSQL and frameworks like React/NextJS, ASP.NET, etc.
*  Fundamentals of AI/Machine Learning
